scriptLines.text: SCORPIO DOESN'T GO COLD. THEY GO QUIET — AND THAT'S WORSE.
THEY CAN LAUGH WITH YOU, ANSWER YOUR TEXTS, AND STILL BE QUIETLY DECIDING IF THEY TRUST YOU ANYMORE.
FROM THE OUTSIDE IT LOOKS LIKE INDIFFERENCE. FROM THE INSIDE IT SOUNDS LIKE A COUNTDOWN.
SCORPIO READS EVERY ROOM BEFORE THEY SPEAK. PEOPLE MISTAKE THAT FOR ARROGANCE. IT'S NEITHER.
BEHIND EVERY "I'M FINE" FROM SCORPIO IS A SENTENCE THEY ALREADY DECIDED YOU WEREN'T READY TO HEAR.
THEY NOTICED. THEY'RE JUST NOT TELLING YOU YET.
SCORPIO DOESN'T LEAVE DURING THE STORM. THEY LEAVE AFTER — QUIETLY, WITHOUT A SCENE, WITH EVERYTHING ALREADY DECIDED.
THE WALL ISN'T THERE TO KEEP YOU OUT. IT'S THERE BECAUSE LAST TIME, NOBODY STOPPED THEM FROM GIVING EVERYTHING.
THE PART OF THEM YOU GOT WAS EARNED, NOT GIVEN. NOBODY TOLD YOU WHICH.
IT ISN'T TRUST THEY'RE PROTECTING. IT'S THE VERSION OF THEMSELVES THAT STILL BELIEVES IN IT.
THEY ARE NOT PULLING AWAY BECAUSE THEY STOPPED CARING. THEY'RE PULLING AWAY BECAUSE STAYING STARTED TO FEEL LIKE BETRAYING THEMSELVES.
AND WHEN SCORPIO FINALLY GOES QUIET, THAT SILENCE USUALLY MEANS THE DECISION HAS ALREADY BEEN MADE.
MOST PEOPLE SEE THE SURFACE. THE SILENCE. THE DISTANCE. THE WAY THEY SEEM UNMOVED WHEN EVERYTHING IS MOVING INSIDE THEM.
IT'S NOT THAT THEY DON'T FEEL IT. IT'S THAT THEY FELT IT FIRST — AND ALONE.
WHEN SCORPIO SOFTENS AROUND YOU, YOU'RE NOT WINNING THEM. YOU'RE BEING TRUSTED.
BUT THE REALITY IS FAR MORE COMPLICATED THAN THAT.
AND WHEN SCORPIO FINALLY LOWERS THAT WALL — EVEN SLIGHTLY — TREAT IT LIKE THE RARE THING IT IS.
